[Matthaios] [1]:[1] The_scroll of_the_birth of_Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) chosen_one/messiah, son of_Dawid/(Dāvid), son of_Abraʼam/(ʼAⱱrāhām):
[Matthaios] [1]:[2] Abraʼam bore the Isaʼak/(Yiʦḩāq), and Isaʼak bore the Yakōb/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ), and Yakōb bore the Youda/(Yəhūdāh) and the brothers of_him,
[Matthaios] [1]:[3] and Youda bore the Fares/(Fereʦ) and the Zara/(Zeraḩ) of the Thamar/(Tāmār), and Fares bore the Hesrōm/(Ḩeʦrōn), and Hesrōm bore the Aram/(Rām),
[Matthaios] [1]:[4] and Aram bore the Aminadab/(ˊAmminādāⱱ), and Aminadab bore the Naʼassōn/(Naḩshōn), and Naʼassōn bore the Salmōn/(Salmōn),
[Matthaios] [1]:[5] and Salmōn bore the Boʼoz/(Boˊaz) of the Ɽaⱪab/(Rāḩāⱱ), and Boʼoz bore the Yōbaʸd/Ōbaʸd/(ˊŌⱱēd) of the Ɽouth/(Rūt), and Yōbaʸd bore the Yessai/(Yishay),
[Matthaios] [1]:[6] and Yessai bore the Dawid the king. And Dawid bore the Solomōn/(Shəlmoh) of the wife of_ the _Ourias/(ʼŪriyyāh),
[Matthaios] [1]:[7] and Solomōn bore the Ɽoboam/(Rəḩaⱱˊām), and Ɽoboam bore the Abia/(ʼAⱱīāh), and Abia bore the Asaf/(ʼĀşāf),
[Matthaios] [1]:[8] and Asaf bore the Yōsafat/(Yəhōshāfāţ), and Yōsafat bore the Yōram/(Yōrām), and Yōram bore the Ozias/(ˊUzziyyāh),
[Matthaios] [1]:[9] and Ozias bore the Yōatham/(Yōtām), and Yōatham bore the Aⱪaz/(ʼĀḩāz), and Aⱪaz bore the Hezekias/(Ḩizqiyyāh),
[Matthaios] [1]:[10] and Hezekias bore the Manassaʸs/(Mənashsheh), and Manassaʸs bore the Amōs/(ʼĀmōʦ), and Amōs bore the Yōsias/(Yʼoshiyyāh),
[Matthaios] [1]:[11] and Yōsias bore the Yeⱪonias/(Yəkonyāh) and the brothers of_him during the deportation to_Babulōn/(Bāⱱel?).
[Matthaios] [1]:[12] And after the deportation to_Babulōn, Yeⱪonias bore the Salathiaʸl/(Shəʼaltiyʼēl), and Salathiaʸl bore the Zorobabel/(Zərubāⱱel),
[Matthaios] [1]:[13] and Zorobabel bore the Abioud/(ʼAⱱīhūd), and Abioud bore the Eliakeim/(ʼElyāqīm), and Eliakeim bore the Azōr/(ˊAzzūr),
[Matthaios] [1]:[14] and Azōr bore the Sadōk/(Tsādōq), and Sadōk bore the Aⱪeim/(Yōqīm), and Aⱪeim bore the Elioud/(ʼĒl-hōd),
[Matthaios] [1]:[15] and Elioud bore the Eleazar/(ʼElˊāzār), and Eleazar bore the Matthan/(Mattān), and Matthan bore the Yakōb,
[Matthaios] [1]:[16] and Yakōb bore the Yōsaʸf/(Yōşēf) the husband of_Maria/(Miryām), of whom was_born Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa), the one being_called the_chosen_one/messiah.
[Matthaios] [1]:[17] Therefore all the generations from Abraʼam/(ʼAⱱrāhām) to Dawid/(Dāvid) were fourteen generations, and from Dawid until the deportation to_Babulōn fourteen generations, and from the deportation to_Babulōn to the chosen_one/messiah fourteen generations.
[Matthaios] [1]:[18] And the birth the of_Yaʸsous chosen_one/messiah was thus: Maria the mother of_him, having_been_betrothed to_ the _Yōsaʸf, before or/than them to_come_together, she_was_found having in womb by the_ holy _spirit.
[Matthaios] [1]:[19] And Yōsaʸf the husband of_her, being righteous and not willing to_expose her, was_counselled to_send_ her _away secretly.
[Matthaios] [1]:[20] But these things having_been_considered of_him, see, a_messenger of_the_master was_seen to_him in a_dream saying: Yōsaʸf, son of_Dawid, may_ not _be_afraid to_receive Maria the wife of_you, because/for the one in her having_been_born is from the_ holy _spirit.
[Matthaios] [1]:[21] And she_will_be_bearing a_son, and you_will_be_calling the name of_him Yaʸsous, because/for he will_be_saving the people of_him from the sins of_them.
[Matthaios] [1]:[22] And all this has_become, in_order_that the thing having_been_spoken by the_master through the prophet may_be_fulfilled saying,
[Matthaios] [1]:[23] Behold, the virgin will_be_having in womb and will_be_bearing a_son, and they_will_be_calling the name of_him Emmanouaʸl/(ˊImmānūʼēl), which is being_translated: - god With us.
[Matthaios] [1]:[24] And the Yōsaʸf/(Yōşēf) having_been_raised from the sleep, did as the messenger of_the_master commanded to_him, and received the wife of_him,
[Matthaios] [1]:[25] and was_ not _knowing her until of_which she_bore a_son, and he_called the name of_him, Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa).
[Matthaios] [2]:[1] And the Yaʸsous having_been_born in Baʸthleʼem/(Bēyt-leḩem) of_ the _Youdaia in the_days of_Haʸrōdaʸs the king, see, wise_men from east arrived in Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim)
[Matthaios] [2]:[2] saying: Where is the one, having_been_born king of_the Youdaiōns? For/Because we_saw the star of_him in the east and we_came to_prostrate before_him.
[Matthaios] [2]:[3] And the king Haʸrōdaʸs having_heard was_disturbed, and all Hierousalaʸm with him.
[Matthaios] [2]:[4] And having_gathered_together all the chief_priests and scribes of_the people, he_was_inquiring from them where the chosen_one/messiah is_being_born.
[Matthaios] [2]:[5] And they said to_him: In Baʸthleʼem of_ the _Youdaia, because/for thus it_has_been_written through the prophet:
[Matthaios] [2]:[6] And you Baʸthleʼem, land of_Youda/(Yəhūdāh), are by_no_means least among the rulers of_Youda, because/for out_of of_you will_be_coming_out a_leading one, who will_be_shepherding the people of_me, the Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl).
[Matthaios] [2]:[7] Then Haʸrōdaʸs having_ secretly _called the wise_men, ascertained from them the time of_the appearing star.
[Matthaios] [2]:[8] And having_sent them to Baʸthleʼem he_said: Having_been_gone, search_out exactly for the little_child, and when you_all_may_find him, report to_me so_that also_I, having_come, may_prostrate before_him.
[Matthaios] [2]:[9] And which having_heard from_the king, they_were_gone, and see, the star, which they_saw in the east, was_going_before them until having_come, it_was_stood over where the little_child was.
[Matthaios] [2]:[10] And having_seen the star, they_were_ exceedingly _elated with_ great _joy.
[Matthaios] [2]:[11] And having_come into the house, they_saw the little_child with Maria/(Miryām) the mother of_him, and having_fallen, they_prostrated before_him, and having_opened_up the treasures of_them, they_offered gifts to_him: gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
[Matthaios] [2]:[12] And having_been_warned in a_dream not to_return to Haʸrōdaʸs, they_withdrew by another way into the country of_them.
[Matthaios] [2]:[13] And having_withdrawn from_them, see, a_messenger of_the_master is_appearing in a_dream to_ the _Yōsaʸf/(Yōşēf) saying: Having_been_raised, take the little_child and the mother of_him, and be_fleeing into Aiguptos/(Miʦrayim), and be there until wishfully I_may_tell to_you, because/for Haʸrōdaʸs is_going to_be_seeking the little_child which to_destroy him.
[Matthaios] [2]:[14] And which having_been_raised, he_took the little_child and the mother of_him by_night and withdrew into Aiguptos,
[Matthaios] [2]:[15] and he_was there until the death of_Haʸrōdaʸs, in_order_that the message may_be_fulfilled having_been_spoken by the_master through the prophet saying: I_called the son of_me out_of of_Aiguptos.
[Matthaios] [2]:[16] Then Haʸrōdaʸs, having_seen that he_was_mocked by the wise_men, was_enraged exceedingly and having_sent_out, he_killed all the boys which in Baʸthleʼem/(Bēyt-leḩem) and in all the regions of_it from two_year and lower, according_to the time which he_ascertained from the wise_men.
[Matthaios] [2]:[17] Then the message was_fulfilled having_been_spoken through Yeremias/(Yirməyāh) the prophet saying,
[Matthaios] [2]:[18] A_voice in Ɽama/(Rāmāh) was_heard, weeping and great mourning, Ɽaⱪaʸl/(Rāḩēl) weeping for_the children of_her, and was_ not _wanting to_be_comforted, because they_are not.
[Matthaios] [2]:[19] But the Haʸrōdaʸs having_died, see, a_messenger of_the_master is_appearing in a_dream to_ the _Yōsaʸf in Aiguptos
[Matthaios] [2]:[20] saying: Having_been_raised, take the little_child and the mother of_him, and be_going into the_land of_Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl), because/for the ones seeking the life of_the little_child have_died.
[Matthaios] [2]:[21] And he having_been_raised, took the little_child and the mother of_him, and came_in into the_land of_Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl).
[Matthaios] [2]:[22] But having_heard that Arⱪelaos is_reigning the over_Youdaia instead_of Haʸrōdaʸs the father of_him, he_was_afraid to_go_away there, and having_been_warned in a_dream, he_withdrew into the districts of_ the _Galilaia/(Gālīl),
[Matthaios] [2]:[23] and having_come, he_dwelt into a_city being_called Nazaret, so_that the message may_be_fulfilled having_been_spoken through the prophets, he_will_be_being_called that A_from_Nazaret.
[Matthaios] [3]:[1] And in the those days Yōannaʸs the immerser is_arriving, proclaiming in the wilderness of_ the _Youdaia
[Matthaios] [3]:[2] saying: Be_repenting, because/for the kingdom of_the heavens has_neared.
[Matthaios] [3]:[3] For/Because this is the one having_been_spoken through Aʸsaias/(Yəshaˊyāh) the prophet saying: The_voice of_a_shouting one in the wilderness prepare the way of_the_master, be_making the paths of_him straight.
[Matthaios] [3]:[4] And the Yōannaʸs himself was_having the clothing of_him from hairs of_a_camel and a_ leather _belt around the waist of_him, and the food of_him was locusts and wild honey.
[Matthaios] [3]:[5] Then Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim), and all the Youdaia, and all the surrounding_region of_the Yordanaʸs/(Yardēn) was_going_out to him,
[Matthaios] [3]:[6] and they_were_being_immersed by him in the Yordanaʸs River, confessing the sins of_them.
[Matthaios] [3]:[7] But having_seen many of_the Farisaios_party and Saddoukaios_sect coming to the immersion of_him, he_said to_them: Brood of_vipers, who warned to_you_all to_flee from the coming severe_anger?
[Matthaios] [3]:[8] Therefore produce fruit worthy of_ the _repentance.
[Matthaios] [3]:[9] And you_all_may_ not _suppose to_be_saying among yourselves, we_are_having the Abraʼam/(ʼAⱱrāhām) father, because/for I_am_saying to_you_all that the god is_able to_raise children to_ the _Abraʼam out_of the these stones.
[Matthaios] [3]:[10] And already the axe is_lying to the root of_the trees, therefore every tree not producing good fruit is_being_cut_off and is_being_thrown into the_fire.
[Matthaios] [3]:[11] I on_one_hand am_immersing you_all in water to repentance, on_the_other_hand the one coming after me is mightier than me, of_whom not I_am worthy to_bear the sandals. He will_be_immersing you_all in the_ holy _spirit and with_fire.
[Matthaios] [3]:[12] Of_whom the winnowing_fork is in the hand of_him, and he_will_be_clearing_out the threshing_floor of_him, and will_be_gathering_together the wheat of_him into the barn, but the chaff he_will_be_burning_up with_ inextinguishable _fire.
[Matthaios] [3]:[13] Then the Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) is_arriving from the Galilaia/(Gālīl) to the Yordanaʸs/(Yardēn) to the Yōannaʸs, which to_be_immersed by him.
[Matthaios] [3]:[14] But the was_forbidding him saying: I am_having need to_be_immersed by you, and you are_coming to me?
[Matthaios] [3]:[15] But the Yaʸsous answering said to him: Allow it now, because/for thus it_is befitting to_us to_fulfill all righteousness. Then he_is_allowing him.
[Matthaios] [3]:[16] And having_been_immersed, the Yaʸsous immediately went_up from the water, and see, the heavens were_opened_up, and he_saw the spirit of_ the _god coming_down as_if a_dove and coming on him.
[Matthaios] [3]:[17] And see, a_voice out_of of_the heavens saying: This is the son of_me, the beloved in whom I_took_pleasure.
[Matthaios] [4]:[1] Then the Yaʸsous was_brought_up into the wilderness by the spirit to_be_tempted by the devil.
[Matthaios] [4]:[2] And having_fasted forty days and forty nights, later he_hungered.
[Matthaios] [4]:[3] And the one tempting having_approached, said to_him: If you_are the_son of_ the _god, speak that the these stones may_become loaves.
[Matthaios] [4]:[4] But he answering said: It_has_been_written: The person not only by bread will_be_living, but by every message going_out through the_mouth of_god.
[Matthaios] [4]:[5] Then the devil is_taking him to the holy city, and stood him on the pinnacle of_the temple,
[Matthaios] [4]:[6] and he_is_saying to_him: If you_are the_son of_ the _god, throw yourself down, because/for it_has_been_written, that Will_be_commanding to_the messengers of_him concerning you, and: They_will_be_carrying you in their_hands, lest you_may_strike the foot of_you against a_stone.
[Matthaios] [4]:[7] The Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) was_saying to_him: In_contrast it_has_been_written: You_˓will˒_ not _be_Testing the_master the god of_you.
[Matthaios] [4]:[8] Again the devil is_taking him to a_ exceedingly high _mountain, and is_showing to_him all the kingdoms of_the world and the glory of_them,
[Matthaios] [4]:[9] and he_said to_him: I_will_be_giving all these things to_you if having_fallen, you_may_prostrate before_me.
[Matthaios] [4]:[10] Then the Yaʸsous is_saying to_him: Be_going_away Satan/(Sāţān), because/for it_has_been_written: You_will_be_prostrating the_master the god of_you, and only unto_him you_will_be_serving.
[Matthaios] [4]:[11] Then the devil is_leaving him, and see, messengers approached and were_serving unto_him.
[Matthaios] [4]:[12] And having_heard that Yōannaʸs was_given_over, he_withdrew into the Galilaia/(Gālīl).
[Matthaios] [4]:[13] And having_left the Nazaret, having_come he_dwelt at Kafarnaʼoum, which is by_the_seaside in the_regions of_Zaboulōn/(Zəⱱūlūn) and Nefthaleim/(Naftālī),
[Matthaios] [4]:[14] in_order_that the message may_be_fulfilled having_been_spoken by Aʸsaias/(Yəshaˊyāh) the prophet saying,
[Matthaios] [4]:[15] Land of_Zaboulōn and land of_Nefthaleim, way of_the_sea, beyond the Yordanaʸs/(Yardēn), Galilaia of_the pagans.
[Matthaios] [4]:[16] The people which sitting in darkness saw a_ great _light, and to_the ones sitting in a_land and shadow of_death, a_light rose on_them.
[Matthaios] [4]:[17] From then the Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) began to_be_proclaiming and to_be_saying: Be_repenting, because/for the kingdom of_the heavens has_neared.
[Matthaios] [4]:[18] And walking beside the sea of_ the _Galilaia he_saw two, brothers, Simōn which being_called Petros and Andreas the brother of_him, casting a_casting_net into the sea, because/for they_were fishermen.
[Matthaios] [4]:[19] And he_is_saying to_them: Come after me, and I_will_be_making you_all fishermen of_people.
[Matthaios] [4]:[20] And which immediately having_left the nets, they_followed after_him.
[Matthaios] [4]:[21] And having_advanced from_there, he_saw two other brothers, Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ) the son of_ the _Zebedaios and Yōannaʸs the brother of_him, in the boat with Zebedaios the father of_them, preparing the nets of_them, and he_called them.
[Matthaios] [4]:[22] And which immediately having_left the boat and the father of_them, they_followed after_him.
[Matthaios] [4]:[23] And the Yaʸsous he_was_going_around in all the Galilaia/(Gālīl), teaching in the synagogues of_them, and proclaiming the good_message of_the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
[Matthaios] [4]:[24] And the report of_him went_away into all the Suria/(ʼArām). And they_brought to_him all the ones sickly, having with_various diseases, and being_gripped_with with_torments, being_demon_possessed, and being_epileptic, and paralytic, and he_healed them.
[Matthaios] [4]:[25] And great crowds followed after_him from the Galilaia, and the_Dekapolis, and Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim), and Youdaia, and beyond the Yordanaʸs/(Yardēn).
[Matthaios] [5]:[1] And having_seen the crowds, he_went_up on the mountain, and him having_sat_down, the apprentices/followers of_him approached to_him.
[Matthaios] [5]:[2] And having_opened_up the mouth of_him, he_was_teaching them saying,
[Matthaios] [5]:[3] Blessed are the poor in_the spirit, because to_them is the kingdom of_the heavens.
[Matthaios] [5]:[4] Blessed are the ones mourning, because they will_be_being_comforted.
[Matthaios] [5]:[5] Blessed are the gentle, because they will_be_inheriting the earth.
[Matthaios] [5]:[6] Blessed are the ones hungering and thirsting the for_righteousness, because they will_be_being_satisfied.
[Matthaios] [5]:[7] Blessed are the merciful, because they will_be_being_shown_mercy.
[Matthaios] [5]:[8] Blessed are the pure the in_heart, because they will_be_seeing the god.
[Matthaios] [5]:[9] Blessed are the peacemaking, because they will_be_being_called sons of_god.
[Matthaios] [5]:[10] Blessed are the ones having_been_persecuted on_account righteousness, because to_them is the kingdom of_the heavens.
[Matthaios] [5]:[11] Blessed are_you_all whenever they_may_deride you_all and may_pursue and lying, they_may_say all evil against you_all on_account of_me.
[Matthaios] [5]:[12] Be_rejoicing and be_exulting, because the reward of_you_all is great in the heavens, because/for thus they_persecuted the prophets which before you_all.
[Matthaios] [5]:[13] You_all are the salt of_the earth, but if the salt may_be_made_tasteless, with what it_will_be_being_salted? It_is_being_effective for nothing anymore, except not/lest having_been_throw out, to_be_being_trampled by the people.
[Matthaios] [5]:[14] You_all are the light of_the world. A_city lying on a_mountain is_ not _able to_be_hidden.
[Matthaios] [5]:[15] And_not they_are_lighting a_lamp and are_putting it under the a_basket, but on the lampstand, and it_is_shining for_all the ones in the house.
[Matthaios] [5]:[16] Thus let_ the light of_you_all _shine before the people, so_that they_may_see the good works of_you_all, and may_glorify the father of_you_all which in the heavens.
[Matthaios] [5]:[17] You_all_may_ not _think that I_came to_tear_down the law or the prophets, I_came not to_tear_down, but to_fulfill.
[Matthaios] [5]:[18] For/Because truly I_am_saying to_you_all, until the heaven and the earth wishfully may_pass_away, one Iota or one serif by_no_means may_ not _pass_away from the law, until wishfully all things may_become.
[Matthaios] [5]:[19] Therefore if whoever may_break the least one of_these of_the commands, and may_teach the people thus, will_be_being_called least in the kingdom of_the heavens, but whoever wishfully may_practice and may_teach, this one will_be_being_called great in the kingdom of_the heavens.
[Matthaios] [5]:[20] For/Because I_am_saying to_you_all that if the righteousness of_you_all not may_be_plentiful more of_the scribes and Farisaios_party, by_no_means you_all_may_ not _come_in into the kingdom of_the heavens.
[Matthaios] [5]:[21] You_all_heard that it_was_said to_the ancients: You_˓will˒_ not _be_murdering, and whoever, wishfully may_murder, will_be liable to_the judgement.
[Matthaios] [5]:[22] But I am_saying to_you_all that everyone which being_angered by_the brother of_him, will_be liable to_the judgement, and whoever wishfully may_say to_the brother of_him: Raca, will_be liable to_the council, and whoever wishfully may_say: Foolish, will_be liable to the geenna of_ the _fire.
[Matthaios] [5]:[23] Therefore if you_may_be_offering the gift of_you at the altar, and_there you_may_be_reminded that the brother of_you is_having something against you,
[Matthaios] [5]:[24] leave the gift of_you there before the altar. And be_going_away, first be_reconciled to_the brother of_you, and then having_come, be_offering the gift of_you.
[Matthaios] [5]:[25] Be agreeing with_the opponent of_you quickly, as_long_as which you_are with him on the way, lest the opponent may_give_ you _over to_the judge, and the judge to_the attendant, and you_will_be_being_thrown into prison.
[Matthaios] [5]:[26] Truly I_am_saying to_you, by_no_means you_may_ not _come_out from_there, until wishfully you_may_give_back the last quadran.
[Matthaios] [5]:[27] You_all_heard that it_was_said: You_˓will˒_ not _be_committing_adultery.
[Matthaios] [5]:[28] But I am_saying to_you_all that everyone which looking at_a_woman in_order that to_lust for_her, already committed_adultery with_her in the heart of_him.
[Matthaios] [5]:[29] And if the the right eye of_you is_stumbling you, pluck_ it _out and throw it from you, because/for it_is_benefitting for_you that one of_the members of_you may_perish, and not all the body of_you may_be_thrown into geenna.
[Matthaios] [5]:[30] And if the right hand of_you is_stumbling you, cut_off it and throw it from you, because/for it_is_benefitting for_you that one of_the members of_you may_perish, and not all the body of_you may_go_away into geenna.
[Matthaios] [5]:[31] And it_was_said: Whoever wishfully may_send_away the wife of_him, let_him_give divorce to_her.
[Matthaios] [5]:[32] But I am_saying to_you_all that everyone which sending_away the wife of_him, except on_account of_sexual_immorality, is_making her to_be_committing_adultery, and whoever may_marry if having_been_sent_ her _away, is_causing_adultery.
[Matthaios] [5]:[33] Furthermore you_all_heard that it_was_said to_the ancients: You_˓will˒_ not _be_perjuring, but you_will_be_giving_back to_the master the oaths of_you.
[Matthaios] [5]:[34] But I am_saying to_you_all not to_ actually _swear, neither by the heaven, because it_is the_throne of_ the _god,
[Matthaios] [5]:[35] nor by the earth, because it_is the_footstool of_the feet of_him, nor in Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim), because it_is the_city of_the great king,

[Matthaios] [5]:[46] For/Because if you_all_may_love the ones loving you_all, what reward are_you_all_having? Not also the tax_collectors are_doing the same?

[Matthaios] [5]:[48] Therefore you_all will_be perfect as the heavenly father of_you_all the is perfect.
[Matthaios] [6]:[1] Be_taking_heed not to_be_practicing the righteousness of_you_all before the people, in_order that to_be_seen by_them, and if not, surely you_all_are_having no reward with the father of_you_all, who is in the heavens.
[Matthaios] [6]:[2] Therefore whenever you_may_be_doing alms, you_may_ not _trumpet before you, as the hypocrites are_doing in the synagogues and in the streets, so_that they_may_be_glorified by the people. Truly, I_am_saying to_you_all, they_are_receiving_fully the reward of_them.

[Matthaios] [6]:[5] And whenever you_may_be_praying, you_all_will_ not _be like the hypocrites, because they_are_loving to_be_praying in the synagogues and having_stood on the corners of_the roads, so_that they_may_be_seen by_the people. Truly, I_am_saying to_you_all, they_are_receiving_fully the reward of_them.
[Matthaios] [6]:[6] But you whenever you_may_be_praying, come_in into the private_room of_you and having_shut the door of_you, pray to_the father of_you, who is in the secret, and the father of_you, the one seeing in the secret, will_be_giving_back to_you.
[Matthaios] [6]:[7] And praying, you_all_may_ not _babble as the pagans for they_are_supposing that in the many_messages of_them they_will_be_being_listened_to.

[Matthaios] [6]:[11] Give to_us today the the daily_needed bread of_us.

[Matthaios] [6]:[19] Be_ not _storing_up treasures on the earth for_you_all, where moth and corrosion is_destroying, and where thieves are_digging_through and are_stealing,

[Matthaios] [6]:[21] For/Because where the treasure of_you is, the heart of_you will_be there also.

[Matthaios] [13]:[7] On_the_other_hand others fell on the thorns, and the thorns went_up and choked_ them _out.
[Matthaios] [13]:[8] On_the_other_hand others fell on the the good soil, and was_giving fruit, some on_one_hand a_hundred, on_the_other_hand some sixty, on_the_other_hand some thirty.
[Matthaios] [13]:[9] The one having ears, let_him_be_hearing.

[Matthaios] [13]:[18] Therefore you_all hear the parable of_the one having_sown.

[Matthaios] [16]:[18] And also_I am_saying to_you that you are Petros, but on this the rock I_will_be_building the assembly of_me, and the_gates of_Haidaʸs ˓will˒_ not _be_prevailing against_it.
[Matthaios] [16]:[19] I_will_be_giving the keys of_the kingdom of_the heavens, to_you, and whatever if you_may_bind on the earth, will_be having_been_bound in the heavens, and whatever if you_may_untie/release on the earth, will_be having_been_untied/released in the heavens.
[Matthaios] [16]:[20] Then he_instructed to_the apprentices/followers that they_may_say to_no_one that he is the chosen_one/messiah.
[Matthaios] [16]:[21] From then the Yaʸsous chosen_one/messiah began to_be_showing to_the apprentices/followers of_him that it_is_fitting him to_go_away to Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim), and to_suffer many things from the elders, and chief_priests, and scribes, and to_be_killed_off and on_the third day to_be_raised.
[Matthaios] [16]:[22] And the Petros having_taken_aside him, he_began to_be_giving_rebuke to_him saying: Merciful be to_you, master, by_no_means this will_ not _be to_you.
[Matthaios] [16]:[23] But he having_been_turned said to_ the _Petros: Be_going behind me, Satan/(Sāţān). You_are a_temptation of_me, because you_are_ not _thinking the things of_ the _god, but the things the of_humans.
[Matthaios] [16]:[24] Then the Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) said to_the apprentices/followers of_him: If anyone is_wanting to_come after me, let_him_renounce himself, and let_him_take_up the stake of_him, and let_him_be_following after_me.
[Matthaios] [16]:[25] For/Because whoever if may_be_wanting to_save the life of_him will_be_losing it, but whoever wishfully may_lose the life of_him on_account me, will_be_finding it.
[Matthaios] [16]:[26] For/Because what ˓will˒_ a_person _be_being_benefitted, if he_may_gain the whole world, but the soul of_him may_be_lost? Or what ˓will˒_ a_person _be_giving as_an_exchange for_the soul of_him?
[Matthaios] [16]:[27] For/Because the son of_ the _man is_going to_be_coming in the glory of_the father of_him with the messengers of_him, and then he_will_be_giving_back to_each according_to the practice of_him.
[Matthaios] [16]:[28] Truly, I_am_saying to_you_all that are some of_the ones having_stood here who by_no_means may_ not _taste of_death, until wishfully they_may_see the son of_ the _man coming in the kingdom of_him.
[Matthaios] [17]:[1] And after six days, the Yaʸsous is_taking the Petros, and Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ), and Yōannaʸs, the brother of_him, and he_is_bringing_up them into a_ high _mountain by themselves.
[Matthaios] [17]:[2] And he_was_transformed before them, and the face of_him shined as the sun, and the clothes of_him became white as the light.
[Matthaios] [17]:[3] And see, Mōsaʸs/(Mosheh) and Aʸlias/(ʼĒliyyāh) was_seen to_them conversing_with with him.
[Matthaios] [17]:[4] And the Petros answering, said to_ the _Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa): master, it_is good us to_be here. If you_are_wanting, I_will_be_making three tents here, one for_you, and one for_Mōsaʸs, and one for_Aʸlias.
[Matthaios] [17]:[5] Him still speaking, see, a_ bright _cloud overshadowed them, and see, a_voice out_of the cloud saying: This is the son of_me, the beloved in whom I_took_pleasure, be_hearing from_him.
[Matthaios] [17]:[6] And having_heard it, the apprentices/followers fell on face of_them and they_were_ exceedingly _afraid.

[Matthaios] [17]:[8] And having_lifted_up the eyes of_them, they_saw no_one except only Yaʸsous not/lest himself.
[Matthaios] [17]:[9] And them coming_down from the mountain, the Yaʸsous commanded to_them saying, you_all_may_tell the vision To_no_one, until of_which the son of_ the _man may_rise_up from the_dead.
[Matthaios] [17]:[10] And the apprentices/followers of_him asked him saying: Why therefore are_ the scribes _saying that Aʸlias it_is_fitting to_come first?
[Matthaios] [17]:[11] And he answering said: Aʸlias on_one_hand is_coming and will_be_restoring all things,
[Matthaios] [17]:[12] on_the_other_hand I_am_saying to_you_all that Aʸlias/(ʼĒliyyāh) already came and they_ not _knew him, but they_did with him as_much_as they_wanted. Thus also the son of_ the _man is_going to_be_suffering by them.
[Matthaios] [17]:[13] Then the apprentices/followers understood that he_spoke to_them concerning Yōannaʸs the immerser.
[Matthaios] [17]:[14] And of_having_come to the crowd, a_man approached to_him kneeling before_him
[Matthaios] [17]:[15] and saying: master, show_mercy to_the son of_me, because he_is_being_epileptic and is_having sickly, because/for often he_is_falling into the fire, and often into the water.
[Matthaios] [17]:[16] And I_brought him to_the apprentices/followers of_you, and they_were_ not _able to_heal him.
[Matthaios] [17]:[17] And the Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) answering said: Oh unbelieving generation and having_been_perverted, until when will_ I _be with you_all? Until when ˓will˒_I_be_tolerating of_you_all? Be_bringing him here to_me.
[Matthaios] [17]:[18] And the Yaʸsous gave_rebuke to_it, and the demon came_out from him, and the boy was_healed from the that hour.
[Matthaios] [17]:[19] Then the apprentices/followers having_approached by themselves to_ the _Yaʸsous said: for_ Why _reason we were_ not _able to_throw_ it _out?
[Matthaios] [17]:[20] And he is_saying to_them: Because_of the little_faith of_you_all. For/Because truly I_am_saying to_you_all, if you_all_may_be_having faith as a_seed of_mustard, you_all_will_be_saying to_ the this _mountain: Move from_here to_there, and it_will_be_moving, and nothing will_be_unattaining for_you_all.
[Matthaios] [17]:[22] And them being_gathered in the Galilaia/(Gālīl), the Yaʸsous said to_them: The son of_ the _man is_going to_be_being_given_over into the_hands of_people,
[Matthaios] [17]:[23] and they_will_be_killing_ him _off, and on_the third day he_will_be_being_raised. And they_were_ exceedingly _sorrowed.
[Matthaios] [17]:[24] And them having_come to Kafarnaʼoum, the ones receiving the two_drachmas approached to_ the _Petros and said: The teacher of_you_all is_ not _paying the two_drachmas?
[Matthaios] [17]:[25] He_is_saying: Yes. And having_come into the house, the Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) preceded him saying: What is_supposing to_you, Simōn? The kings of_the earth are_receiving revenues or poll_tax from whom_all? From the sons of_them or from the strangers?
[Matthaios] [17]:[26] the Petros is_saying to_him From the strangers. And he_having_said: From the strangers, the Yaʸsous was_saying to_him: Consequently surely the_free ones are the sons.
[Matthaios] [17]:[27] But in_order_that we_may_ not _offend them, having_been_gone to sea, throw a_fish_hook and take_up the first fish having_gone_up, and having_opened_up the mouth of_it, you_will_be_finding a_stater, having_taken that, give to_them for me and you.
[Matthaios] [18]:[1] In that the hour the apprentices/followers approached to_ the _Yaʸsous saying: Who consequently is the_greater in the kingdom of_the heavens?
[Matthaios] [18]:[2] And having_called_to a_little_child, he_stood it in midst of_them
[Matthaios] [18]:[3] and said: Truly, I_am_saying to_you_all, if you_all_may_ not _be_turned and may_become as the little_children, by_no_means you_all_may_ not _come_in into the kingdom of_the heavens.
[Matthaios] [18]:[4] Therefore whoever will_be_humbling himself as the this little_child, this one is the greater in the kingdom of_the heavens.
[Matthaios] [18]:[5] And whoever if may_receive one such little_child in the name of_me, is_receiving me.
[Matthaios] [18]:[6] But whoever wishfully may_stumble one of_ the these _little ones which believing in me, it_is_benefitting for_him that a_ heavy _grinding_stone may_be_hanged around the neck of_him, and may_be_sunk in the depth of_the sea.
[Matthaios] [18]:[7] Woe to_the world because_of the temptations. For/Because it_is necessity the temptations to_come, however woe to_the that person by whom the temptation is_coming.
[Matthaios] [18]:[8] And if the hand of_you or the foot of_you is_stumbling you, cut_ it _off and throw it from you, it_is better for_you to_come_in into the life maimed or lame, than to_be_thrown into the the eternal fire having two hands or two feet.
[Matthaios] [18]:[9] And if the eye of_you is_stumbling you, pluck_out it and throw it from you, it_is better for_you to_come_in into the life one-eyed, than to_be_thrown into the geenna of_ the _fire having two eyes.
[Matthaios] [18]:[10] Be_seeing you_all_may_ not _despise of_one of_ the these _little ones, because/for I_am_saying to_you_all that the messengers of_them in the_heavens, through everything are_seeing the face of_the father of_me, who is in the_heavens.
[Matthaios] [18]:[12] What is_it_supposing to_you_all? If it_may_become to_a_certain man a_hundred sheep, and one of them may_be_strayed, not, having_left the ninety nine on the mountains and having_been_gone, is_seeking the sheep being_strayed?
[Matthaios] [18]:[13] And if he_may_become to_find it, truly, I_am_saying to_you_all that he_is_rejoicing over it more than over the ninety nine which not having_been_strayed.
[Matthaios] [18]:[14] Thus is not the_will before the father of_you_all, who is in the_heavens, that may_perish one of_ the these _little ones.
[Matthaios] [18]:[15] And if the brother of_you may_sin, be_going, rebuke him between you and him only. If he_may_hear from_you, you_gained the brother of_you.
[Matthaios] [18]:[16] But if he_may_ not _hear, take one or two more with you in_order_that on the_mouth of_two or three witnesses, every message may_be_established.
[Matthaios] [18]:[17] And if he_may_refuse_to_hear from_them, tell to_the assembly. And if he_may_ also _refuse_to_hear from_the assembly, him_let_be to_you as the pagan and the tax_collector.
[Matthaios] [18]:[18] Truly, I_am_saying to_you_all, as_much_as wishfully you_all_may_bind on the earth, will_be having_been_bound in heaven, and as_much_as if you_all_may_untie/release on the earth, will_be having_been_untied/released in heaven.
[Matthaios] [18]:[19] Furthermore truly, I_am_saying to_you_all that if two of you_all on the earth may_agree_together concerning any matter, of_whatever if they_may_request, it_will_be_becoming for_them by the father of_me, who is in the_heavens.
[Matthaios] [18]:[20] For/Because where are two or three having_been_gathered_together in the my name, there I_am in the_midst of_them.
[Matthaios] [18]:[21] Then the Petros having_approached, said to_him: master, how_often ˓will˒_ the brother of_me _be_sinning against me, and I_will_be_forgiving to_him? Up_to seven_times?
[Matthaios] [18]:[22] The Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) is_saying to_him: I_am_ not _saying to_you up_to seven_times, but up_to seventy_times seven.
[Matthaios] [18]:[23] Because_of this the kingdom of_the heavens was_likened to_a_man, a_king, who wanted to_settle_accounts account with the slaves of_him.
[Matthaios] [18]:[24] And of_him having_begun to_be_settling_accounts, one a_debtor of_ten_thousand talantons_of_silver was_brought to_him.
[Matthaios] [18]:[25] But of_him not having means to_give_back, the master commanded him to_be_sold, and the wife, and the children, and all things as_many_as was_having, and payment to_be_given_back.
[Matthaios] [18]:[26] Therefore the slave having_fallen, was_prostrating to_him saying: Master, be_patient with me, and I_will_be_giving_ all things _back to_you.
[Matthaios] [18]:[27] And the master having_been_feeling_compassion, of_ the that _slave sent_ him _away, and he_forgave the loan to_him.
[Matthaios] [18]:[28] But the that slave having_come_out, found one of_the fellow-slaves of_him, who was_owing a_hundred daʸnarion_coins to_him, and having_apprehended him, he_was_strangling him saying: Give_back if anything you_are_owing.

[Matthaios] [18]:[30] And which he_was_ not _willing, but having_gone_away, he_throw him into prison, until he_may_give_back the thing being_owed.

[Matthaios] [20]:[1] For/Because the kingdom of_the heavens is similar to_a_man, a_home_owner, who came_out together_with in_the_morning to_hire workers for the vineyard of_him.

[Matthaios] [20]:[24] And having_heard, the ten resented about the two brothers.
[Matthaios] [20]:[25] But the Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) having_called_to them said: You_all_have_known that the rulers of_the pagans are_exercising_mastership over_them, and the great ones are_exercising_authority over_them.
[Matthaios] [20]:[26] It_will_ not _be thus among you_all, but whoever if among you_all may_be_wanting to_become great, he_will_be servant of_you_all,

[Matthaios] [20]:[28] as the son of_ the _man came not to_be_served, but to_serve and to_give the life of_him a_ransom for many.
[Matthaios] [20]:[29] And them going_out from Yeriⱪō/(Yərīḩō), a_ great _crowd followed after_him.
[Matthaios] [20]:[30] And see, two blind men sitting beside the road, having_heard that Yaʸsous is_passing_by, they_cried_out saying, show_mercy to_us, master, son of_Dawid/(Dāvid).
[Matthaios] [20]:[31] And the crowd warned to_them that they_may_keep_silent. But they cried_out greater saying: master, son of_Dawid, show_mercy to_us.
[Matthaios] [20]:[32] And the Yaʸsous having_stopped, called them and said: What are_you_all_wanting I_may_do for_you_all?
[Matthaios] [20]:[33] They_are_saying to_him: master, that may_be_opening_up the eyes of_us.
[Matthaios] [20]:[34] And the Yaʸsous having_been_feeling_compassion, touched against_the eyes of_them, and immediately they_received_sight and they_followed after_him.
[Matthaios] [21]:[1] And when they_neared to Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim) and came to Baʸthfagaʸ to the Mount of_ the _Olives, then Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) sent_out two apprentices/followers
[Matthaios] [21]:[2] saying to_them: Be_going into the village which in_front_of of_you_all, and immediately you_all_will_be_finding a_donkey having_been_bound and a_colt with her, having_untied them bring them to_me.
[Matthaios] [21]:[3] And if anyone may_say anything to_you_all, you_all_will_be_saying, that The master is_having need of_them, and immediately he_will_be_sending_ them _out.
[Matthaios] [21]:[4] And this all has_become, in_order_that the message may_be_fulfilled having_been_spoken by the prophet saying,

[Matthaios] [21]:[10] And of_him having_come_in into Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim), all the city was_shaken saying: Who is this?

[Matthaios] [21]:[13] And he_is_saying to_them: It_has_been_written: The house of_me will_be_being_called a_house of_prayer, but you_all are_making it a_hideout of_robbers.

[Matthaios] [21]:[17] And having_left them, he_came_out out the city to Baʸthania, and was_lodged there.
[Matthaios] [21]:[18] And in_the_morning, setting_out into the city, he_hungered.
[Matthaios] [21]:[19] And having_seen one fig_tree on the road, he_came to it and found nothing on it, except not/lest only leaves, and he_is_saying to_it: Fruit may_ no_longer _become from you for the age. And immediately the fig_tree was_withered.
[Matthaios] [21]:[20] And the apprentices/followers having_seen it, marvelled saying: How was_ the fig_tree immediately _withered?

[Matthaios] [21]:[22] And all things, as_many_as wishfully you_all_may_request in the prayer believing, you_all_will_be_receiving.

[Matthaios] [21]:[25] The immersion which of_Yōannaʸs, from_where was_it? From heaven or from humans? And they were_reasoning among themselves saying: If we_may_say: From heaven, he_will_be_saying to_us: Therefore for_ why _reason you_all_ not _believed in_him?
[Matthaios] [21]:[26] But if we_may_say: From humans, we_are_fearing the crowd, because/for all are_having the Yōannaʸs as a_prophet.

[Matthaios] [21]:[28] But what is_it_supposing to_you_all? A_man was_having two children. And having_approached to_the_ first _one he_said: Child, be_going today, be_working in the vineyard of_me.
[Matthaios] [21]:[29] And he answering said: I_am_ not _willing, later having_been_regretful, he_went_away.
[Matthaios] [21]:[30] And having_approached to_the other child, he_said likewise. And he answering said: I will, master, but went_ not _away.
[Matthaios] [21]:[31] Which of the two did the will of_the father? They_are_saying: The first. The Yaʸsous is_saying to_them: Truly, I_am_saying to_you_all that the tax_collectors and the prostitutes are_going_before you_all into the kingdom of_ the _god.
[Matthaios] [21]:[32] For/Because Yōannaʸs came to you_all in the_way of_righteousness, and you_all_ not _believed in_him, but the tax_collectors and the prostitutes believed in_him, and you_all having_seen, you_all_were_ not _regretful later which to_believe in_him.
[Matthaios] [21]:[33] Hear another parable: a_man was a_home_owner, who planted a_vineyard, and put_ a_fence _around to_it: and dug a_wine-press in it, and built a_tower, and rented_ it _out to_tenant_farmers, and travelled.
[Matthaios] [21]:[34] And when the season of_the fruits neared, he_sent_out the slaves of_him to the tenant_farmers, to_receive the fruits of_him.
[Matthaios] [21]:[35] And the tenant_farmers having_taken the slaves of_him, on_one_hand that they_beat, on_the_other_hand that they_killed_off, on_the_other_hand that they_threw_stones.
[Matthaios] [21]:[36] Again he_sent_out other slaves, more than_the first, and they_did likewise to_them.
[Matthaios] [21]:[37] But later he_sent_out the son of_him to them saying: They_will_be_being_swayed by_the son of_me.
[Matthaios] [21]:[38] But the tenant_farmers having_seen the son, said among themselves: This is the heir, come, we_may_kill_ him _off and we_may_have the inheritance of_him.
[Matthaios] [21]:[39] And having_taken him, they_throw_out him out the vineyard and they_killed_ him _off.

[Matthaios] [21]:[41] They_are_saying to_him: He_will_be_destroying them evil ones miserably, and will_be_renting_out the vineyard to_other tenant_farmers, who will_be_giving_back to_him the fruits in the seasons of_them.
[Matthaios] [21]:[42] The Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) is_saying to_them: You_all_ never _read in the scriptures: The_stone which the ones building rejected, this was_become for the_head of_the_corner, this became from the_master, and it_is marvellous in the_eyes of_us?
[Matthaios] [21]:[43] Because_of this I_am_saying to_you_all, that the kingdom of_ the _god will_be_being_taken_away from you_all and it_will_be_being_given to_a_people producing the fruits of_it.
[Matthaios] [21]:[44] And the one having_fallen on the this stone, will_be_being_shattered, on but whomever wishfully it_may_fall, it_will_be_pulverising him.

[Markos] [12]:[4] And again he_sent_out another slave to them, and_that one they_struck_on_the_head and dishonoured.

[Loukas] [2]:[10] And the messenger said to_them: Be_ not _fearing, because/for see, I_am_good_message_preaching to_you_all great joy, which will_be to_all the people,
[Loukas] [2]:[11] because today a_saviour was_born to_you_all, who is the_chosen_one/messiah, the_master, in the_city of_Dawid.
[Loukas] [2]:[12] And this is the sign to_you_all: you_all_will_be_finding a_baby having_been_swaddled, and lying in a_manger.
[Loukas] [2]:[13] And suddenly a_multitude of_the_ heavenly _army became with the messenger, praising the god and saying,
[Loukas] [2]:[14] Glory to_god in the_highest, and peace on earth among humans with_good_pleasure.
[Loukas] [2]:[15] And it_became as the messengers went_away from them into the heaven, the shepherds were_saying to one_another: We_may_ indeed _pass_through as_far_as Baʸthleʼem/(Bēyt-leḩem), and we_may_see the message this the thing having_become, which the master made_known to_us.
[Loukas] [2]:[16] And came having_hurried, and sought_out the both Maria/(Miryām) and the Yōsaʸf/(Yōşēf), and the baby, lying in the manger.
[Loukas] [2]:[17] And having_seen, they_made_known concerning the saying which having_been_spoken to_them, concerning the this little_child.
[Loukas] [2]:[18] And all the ones having_heard, marvelled concerning the things having_been_spoken by the shepherds to them.
[Loukas] [2]:[19] But the Maria was_treasuring all the these messages, considering them in the heart of_her.
[Loukas] [2]:[20] And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising the god for all things which they_heard and saw, as was_spoken to them.
[Loukas] [2]:[21] And when eight days were_fulfilled which to_circumcise him, also the name of_him was_called Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa), which having_been_called by the messenger before the time him to_be_conceived in the womb.
[Loukas] [2]:[22] And when the days of_the purification of_them according_to the law of_Mōsaʸs/(Mosheh) were_fulfilled, they_brought_ him _up to Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim) to_present to_the master,
[Loukas] [2]:[23] as it_has_been_written in the_law of_the_master, that Every male opening_up a_womb, will_be_being_called holy to_the master,
[Loukas] [2]:[24] and which to_give a_sacrifice, according_to the message having_been_said in the law of_the_master: A_pair two of_turtledoves or young of_doves.
[Loukas] [2]:[25] And see, a_man was in Hierousalaʸm, whose name was Sumeōn/(Shimˊōn), and the this_ man _was righteous and devout, waiting_for the_comfort of_ the _Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl), and the_ holy _spirit was on him.
[Loukas] [2]:[26] And was having_been_revealed to_him by the the holy spirit, to_ not _see death before wishfully he_may_see the chosen_one/messiah of_the_master.
[Loukas] [2]:[27] And he_came in the spirit into the temple, and at the time the parents to_bring_in, the little_child Yaʸsous, them to_do of_the thing according_to the thing having_been_accustomed by_the law for him,
[Loukas] [2]:[28] and he received him into the arms, and blessed the god and said,
[Loukas] [2]:[29] Now you_are_sending_away the slave of_you, master, in peace according_to the message of_you,
[Loukas] [2]:[30] because the eyes of_me saw the salvation of_you,
[Loukas] [2]:[31] which you_prepared in the_face of_all the peoples,
[Loukas] [2]:[32] a_light for revelation of_the_pagans and glory of_the_people of_you, Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl).
[Loukas] [2]:[33] And the father of_him and the mother was marvelling at the things being_spoken concerning him.
[Loukas] [2]:[34] And Sumeōn blessed them, and said to Maria/(Miryām) the mother of_him: Behold, this one is_appointing for the_fall and the_resurrection of_many in the Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl), and for a_sign being_spoken_against,
[Loukas] [2]:[35] also a_sword will_be_passing_through the soul of_you of_yourself, so_that the_speculations wishfully of many hearts may_be_revealed.
[Loukas] [2]:[36] And Hanna was a_prophetess, daughter of_Fanouaʸl, of the_tribe of_Asaʸr/(ʼĀshēr), this woman having_advanced in great days, having_lived with a_husband seven years from the virginity of_her,
[Loukas] [2]:[37] and she was a_widow until eighty four years, who not was_withdrawing from_the temple, with_fastings and petitions serving night and day.
[Loukas] [2]:[38] And to_the_same the hour she_having_approached, was_giving_praise the to_god, and was_speaking concerning him, to_all the ones waiting_for the_redemption in_Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim).
[Loukas] [2]:[39] And when they_accomplished all the things according_to the law of_the_master, they_returned to the Galilaia/(Gālīl), to Nazaret the_city of_themselves.
[Loukas] [2]:[40] And the little_child was_growing and was_being_strengthened, being_filled with_wisdom, and the_grace of_god was on him.
[Loukas] [2]:[41] And the parents of_him were_going to Hierousalaʸm in_every year to_the feast of_the passover_feast.
[Loukas] [2]:[42] And when he_became of_ twelve _years, them going_up according_to the custom of_the feast,
[Loukas] [2]:[43] and having_completed the days, in the time them to_be_returning, the boy Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) remained, in Hierousalaʸm, but the parents of_him not. knew.
[Loukas] [2]:[44] But having_thought him to_be in the caravan, they_came the_journey of_a_day and they_were_seeking_ him _out among the relatives and the acquaintances,
[Loukas] [2]:[45] and not having_found him, they_returned to Hierousalaʸm, seeking_ him _out.
[Loukas] [2]:[46] And it_became after three days, they_found him in the temple, sitting in the_midst of_the teachers, both hearing from_them and asking them.
[Loukas] [2]:[47] And all the ones hearing from_him were_marvelling at the intelligence and the answers of_him.
[Loukas] [2]:[48] And having_seen him, they_were_astonished and the mother of_him said to him: Child, why did_you thus to_us? Behold, the father of_you and_I, being_distressed were_seeking you.
[Loukas] [2]:[49] And he_said to them: Why is_it that you_all_were_seeking me? You_all_had_ not _known that in the house of_the father of_me it_is_fitting me to_be?
[Loukas] [2]:[50] And they not understood the message which he_spoke to_them.
[Loukas] [2]:[51] And he_came_down with them and came to Nazaret, and was being_subjected to_them. And the mother of_him was_keeping all the messages in the heart of_her.
[Loukas] [2]:[52] And Yaʸsous was_progressing the in_wisdom, and stature, and favour with god and people.
[Loukas] [3]:[1] And in the_ fifteenth _year of_the government of_Tiberios Kaisar, Pontios Pilatos was governing of_ the _Youdaia, and Haʸrōdaʸs being_quarter_ruler of_ the _Galilaia/(Gālīl), And Filippos the brother of_him being_quarter_ruler of_ the _Itouraios and Traⱪōnitis region, and Lusanios the being_quarter_ruler of_Abilaʸnaʸ,

[Loukas] [3]:[6] and all flesh will_be_seeing the salvation of_ the _god.

[Loukas] [3]:[8] Therefore produce fruits worthy of_ the _repentance, and you_all_may_ not _begin to_be_saying in yourselves, we_are_having the Abraʼam/(ʼAⱱrāhām) As_father, because/for I_am_saying to_you_all that the god is_able to_raise children to_ the _Abraʼam from the these stones.
[Loukas] [3]:[9] And already also the axe is_lying to the root of_the trees, therefore every tree not producing good fruit, is_being_cut_off and is_being_thrown into the_fire.
[Loukas] [3]:[10] And the crowds were_asking him saying: Therefore what may_we_do?

[Loukas] [3]:[12] And tax_collectors also came to_be_immersed, and they_said to him: Teacher, what may_we_do?

[Loukas] [3]:[17] of_whom the winnowing_fork is in the hand of_him to_clear_out the threshing_floor of_him, and to_gather_together the wheat into the barn of_him, and he_will_be_burning_up the the_chaff with_ inextinguishable _fire.
[Loukas] [3]:[18] Therefore also exhorting many other things indeed, he_was_good_message_preaching to_the people.

[Loukas] [4]:[1] And Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) full of_the_ holy _spirit, returned from the Yordanaʸs/(Yardēn), and was_being_led by the spirit in the wilderness,
[Loukas] [4]:[2] being_tempted forty days by the devil. And he_ not _ate nothing in the those days, and them having_been_completed, he_hungered.
[Loukas] [4]:[3] And the devil said to_him: If you_are the_son of_ the _god, say the to_ this _stone that it_may_become bread.
[Loukas] [4]:[4] And the Yaʸsous answered to him: It_has_been_written, that the person only Not on bread will_be_living.
[Loukas] [4]:[5] And having_brought_ him _up he_showed to_him all the kingdoms of_the inhabited_world in a_moment of_time.
[Loukas] [4]:[6] And the devil said to_him: I_will_be_giving to_you the all this domain and the glory of_them, because has_been_given_over to_me and I_am_giving it to_whom if I_may_be_wanting.
[Loukas] [4]:[7] Therefore if you you_may_prostrate before me, everyone will_be of_you.

[Loukas] [4]:[20] And having_rolled_up the scroll having_given_back it to_the attendant, he_sat_down and the eyes of_all in the synagogue were looking_intently at_him.

[Loukas] [4]:[22] And all were_testifying to_him, and were_marvelling at the messages of_ the _grace which going_out out_of the mouth of_him, and they_were_saying, is this Not the_son of_Yōsaʸf/(Yōşēf)?

[Loukas] [5]:[1] And it_became at the time, the crowd to_be_imposing on_him and to_be_hearing the message of_the god, and he was having_stood by the lake of_Gennaʸsaret,
[Loukas] [5]:[2] and he_saw two boats having_stopped by the lake, but the fishermen from them having_gone_out, were_washing the nets.

[Loukas] [13]:[4] Or those the eighteen on whom the tower in the Silōam fell and killed_ them _off, are_you_all_supposing that they became debtors beyond all the people which dwelling_in Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim)?
[Loukas] [13]:[5] No, I_am_saying to_you_all, but if you_all_may_ not _be_repenting, all will_be_perishing likewise.
[Loukas] [13]:[6] And he_was_speaking this the parable: Someone was_having a_fig_tree having_been_planted in the vineyard of_him, and he_came seeking fruit on it, and he_ not _found any.
[Loukas] [13]:[7] And he_said to the Vinedresser, see three, years from that I_am_coming seeking fruit on the this fig_tree, and I_am_ not _finding any. cut_ it _off, because/for_ why _reason it_is_ even _wasting the ground?
[Loukas] [13]:[8] And he answering is_saying to_him: Master, allow it also this the year, until of_which I_may_dig around it and I_may_put manure,
[Loukas] [13]:[9] and_if on_one_hand it_may_produce fruit in the time coming, on_the_other_hand if not surely you_will_be_cutting_ it _off.
[Loukas] [13]:[10] And he_was teaching in one of_the synagogues on the days_of_rest.
[Loukas] [13]:[11] And see, a_woman having a_spirit of_sickness eighteen years, and she_was bending_over and not being_able to_straighten_up to the full_extent.
[Loukas] [13]:[12] And having_seen her, the Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) calling_out and said to_her: Woman, you_have_been_sent_away from_the sickness of_you.
[Loukas] [13]:[13] And he_laid_on his hands on_her, and immediately she_was_restored and was_glorifying the god.
[Loukas] [13]:[14] But the synagogue_leader answering, resenting because the Yaʸsous healed on_the day_of_rest, he_was_saying to_the crowd, because Six days are in which it_is_fitting to_be_working, therefore coming in them be_being_healed, and not on_the day of_the day_of_rest.
[Loukas] [13]:[15] And the master answered to_him and said: Hypocrites. Is_ not _untying each of_you_all the ox of_him, on_the day_of_rest, or the donkey from the manger, and having_led_away it is_giving_to_drink it?
[Loukas] [13]:[16] And this being daughter of_Abraʼam/(ʼAⱱrāhām), whom the Satan/(Sāţān) bound, see, ten and eight years, it_was_ not _fitting to_be_untied/released from the this bond on_the day of_the day_of_rest?
[Loukas] [13]:[17] And saying of_him these things, all the ones opposing to_him were_being_disgraced, and all the crowd was_rejoicing at all the glorious things which becoming by him.
[Loukas] [13]:[18] Therefore he_was_saying: To_what is the kingdom of_ the _god similar, and to_what I_will_be_likening it?
[Loukas] [13]:[19] It_is similar to_a_seed of_mustard, which a_man having_taken, throw into garden of_himself, and it_grew and became into a_tree, and The birds of_the sky nested in the branches of_it.
[Loukas] [13]:[20] And furthermore he_said: To_what I_will_be_likening the kingdom of_ the _god?
[Loukas] [13]:[21] It_is similar to_leaven, which a_woman having_taken, hid_in in three satons of_wheat_flour, until all of_which was_leavened.
[Loukas] [13]:[22] And he_was_passing_ by _through cities and villages teaching, and making journey toward Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim).
[Loukas] [13]:[23] And someone said to_him: master, if the ones being_saved are few? And he said to them,
[Loukas] [13]:[24] Be_striving to_come_in through the narrow door, because I_am_saying to_you_all many, will_be_seeking to_come_in and they_˓will˒_ not _be_able.

[Loukas] [13]:[30] And see, there_are last ones who will_be first ones, and there_are first ones who will_be last ones.

[Loukas] [13]:[32] And he_said to_them: Having_been_gone say to_the this fox: Behold, I_am_casting_out demons, and I_am_finishing_out healings today and tomorrow, and on_the third day I_am_being_perfected.
[Loukas] [13]:[33] However it_is_fitting me, to_be_going today and tomorrow and on_the day following, because it_is_ not _permitting a_prophet to_perish outside Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim).

[Loukas] [23]:[42] And he_was_saying: Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa), Be_reminded of_me, whenever you_may_come in the kingdom of_you.
[Loukas] [23]:[43] And he_said to_him: Truly, I_am_saying to_you, today you_will_be with me in the paradise.

[Loukas] [23]:[51] (this one was not having_consented_with with_the counsel and the practice of_them), from Arimathaia, a_city of_the Youdaiōns, who was_waiting_for the kingdom of_ the _god.

[Loukas] [24]:[1] But on_the first day of_the week, early dawn, they_came to the tomb, bringing spices which they_prepared.
[Loukas] [24]:[2] And they_found the stone having_been_rolled_away from the tomb.
[Loukas] [24]:[3] But having_come_in, they_ not _found the body of_the master Yaʸsous.
[Loukas] [24]:[4] And it_became at the time them to_be_perplexing about this, and see, two men approached to_them in flashing clothing.
[Loukas] [24]:[5] And them having_become frightened, and bowing their faces to the ground, they_said to them: Why are_you_all_seeking the_ living _one with the dead?

[Loukas] [24]:[8] And they_were_reminded of_the messages of_him.

[Loukas] [24]:[11] And the these messages were_seen before them as_if nonsense, and they_were_disbelieving to_them.
[Loukas] [24]:[12] But the Petros having_risen_up, ran to the tomb, and having_stooped_down, is_seeing only the linen_cloths, and he_went_away to himself, wondering at_the thing having_become.
[Loukas] [24]:[13] And see, two of them at same the day were going to a_village being_ sixty stadiums _away from Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim), to_whose name is Emmaous.

[Loukas] [24]:[15] And it_became at the time, them to_be_conversing and to_be_debating, and Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) himself having_neared, was_going_with with_them.
[Loukas] [24]:[16] But the eyes of_them were_being_restrained which to_ not _know him.

[Loukas] [24]:[18] And the_one by_the_name Kleopas answering said to him, are_ you only _sojourning to_Hierousalaʸm and you_ not _knew the things having_become in it in the these days?

[Loukas] [24]:[21] But we were_hoping that he is the one going to_be_redeeming the Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl). But surely also with all these things, it_is_coming this third day, from which these things became.
[Loukas] [24]:[22] But also some women from us, amazed us, having_become early to the tomb

[Loukas] [24]:[24] And some of_the ones with us went_away to the tomb, and they_found it thus, as the women said, but they_ not _saw him.

[Loukas] [24]:[28] And they_neared to the village where they_were_going, and he seemed to_be_going farther_away.

[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[1] In the_beginning was the message, and the message was with the god, and god was the message.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[2] This one was in the_beginning with the god.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[3] All things became through him, and without him not_even one thing became that has_become.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[4] In him was life, and the life was the light of_ the _mankind.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[5] And the light is_shining in the darkness, and it not grasped the darkness.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[6] A_man became having_been_sent_out from god, Yōannaʸs the_name to_him was.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[7] This one came for a_testimony, in_order_that he_may_testify concerning the light, in_order_that all may_believe through him.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[8] That one was not the light, but in_order_that he_may_testify concerning the light.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[9] It_was the the true light, which is_enlightening every person, coming into the world.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[10] He_was in the world, and the world became through him, and the world not knew him.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[11] He_came to his own, and his own not received him.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[12] But as_many_as received him, he_gave to_them the_right to_become children of_god, to_the ones believing in the name of_him,
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[13] who were_born neither of bloods, nor of will of_flesh, nor of will of_man, but of god.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[14] And the message became flesh and sheltered among us, and we_saw the glory of_him, a_glory as of_an_only_begotten with a_father, full of_grace and truth.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[15] Yōannaʸs is_testifying concerning him, and he_has_cried_out saying: This one was whom I_said: The one coming after me, has_become before of_me, because he_was before me.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[16] Because of the fullness of_him, we all received and grace for grace.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[17] Because the law was_given through Mōsaʸs/(Mosheh), the grace and the truth became through Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) chosen_one/messiah.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[18] No_one has_ ever _seen god, the_only_begotten god, the one being in the bosom of_the father, that one explained him.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[19] And this is the testimony of_ the _Yōannaʸs, when the Youdaiōns sent_out priests and Levites from Hierousalaʸm/(Yərūshālayim), in_order_that they_may_ask him: Who are you?
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[20] And he_confessed and not disowned, but confessed, that I am not the chosen_one/messiah.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[21] And they_asked him, What therefore? Are you Aʸlias/(ʼĒliyyāh)? And he_is_saying: I_am not. Are you the prophet? And he_answered: No.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[22] Therefore they_said to_him: Who are_you? In_order_that we_may_give an_answer to_the ones having_sent us. What are_you_saying about yourself?
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[23] He_was_saying: I am A_voice shouting in the wilderness straighten the way of_the_master, as Aʸsaias/(Yəshaˊyāh) the prophet said.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[24] And having_been_sent_out they_were from the Farisaios_party.
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[25] And they_asked him and they_said to_him: Therefore why you_are_immersing, if you not are the chosen_one/messiah, nor Aʸlias, nor the prophet?
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[26] The Yōannaʸs answered to_them saying: I am_immersing in water, in_the_midst of_you_all one_has_stood whom you_all have_ not _known,
[Yōannaʸs] [1]:[27] the one coming after me, of_whom I am not worthy that I_may_untie the strap of_the sandal of_him.

[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[1] And was a_man of the Farisaios_party, Nikodaʸmos the_name to_him, a_ruler of_the Youdaiōns,
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[2] this one came to him by_night, and said to_him: My_great_one, we_have_known that you_have_come from god as_a_teacher, because/for no_one is_able to_be_doing these the signs, what you are_doing, if the god not may_be with him.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[3] Yaʸsous answered and said to_him: Truly, truly, I_am_saying to_you, if anyone not may_be_born again, he_is_ not _able to_see the kingdom of_ the _god.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[4] Nikodaʸmos is_saying to him: How is_ a_person _able to_be_born, being old? He_is_ not _able to_come_in into the womb of_the mother of_him secondly and to_be_born?
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[5] Yaʸsous answered: Truly, truly, I_am_telling to_you, if anyone not may_be_born of water and of_spirit, he_is_ not _able to_come_in into the kingdom the of_god.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[6] The thing having_been_born of the flesh, is flesh, and the thing having_been_born of the spirit, is spirit.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[7] You_may_ not _wonder that I_said to_you: It_is_fitting you_all to_be_born again.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[8] The spirit it_is_blowing where is_wanting, and you_are_hearing the sound of_it, but you_have_ not _known from_where it_is_coming, and where it_is_going, thus is everyone which having_been_born of the spirit.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[9] Nikodaʸmos answered and said to_him: How is_ these things _able to_become?
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[10] Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) answered and said to_him: You are the teacher of_ the _Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl), and you_are_ not _knowing these things?
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[11] Truly, truly, I_am_saying to_you that we_are_speaking what we_have_known, and we_are_testifying what we_have_seen, and you_all_are_ not _receiving the testimony of_us.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[12] If I_told the earthly things to_you_all, and you_all_are_ not _believing, how you_all_will_be_believing if I_may_tell to_you_all the heavenly things?
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[13] And no_one has_gone_up into the heaven, except not/lest the one having_come_down out_of the heaven, the son of_ the _Man.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[14] And as Mōsaʸs/(Mosheh) exalted the serpent in the wilderness, thus it_is_fitting the son of_ the _man to_be_exalted,
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[15] in_order_that everyone which believing in him may_be_having eternal life.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[16] For/Because thus the god loved the world, so_that he_gave the the only_begotten son, in_order_that everyone which believing in him may_ not _perish, but may_be_having eternal life.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[17] For/Because the god not sent_out his son into the world, in_order_that he_may_judge the world, but in_order_that the world may_be_saved through him.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[18] The one believing in him not is_being_judged. But the one not believing, has_been_ already _judged, because he_has_ not _believed in the name of_the only_begotten son of_ the _god.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[19] And this is the judgement, that the light has_come into the world, and the people loved the darkness rather than the light, because/for the works of_them was evil.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[20] For/Because everyone which doing evil, is_hating the light, and is_ not _coming to the light, in_order_that the works of_him may_be_ not _rebuked.
[Yōannaʸs] [3]:[21] But the one practicing the truth, is_coming to the light, in_order_that the works of_him may_be_revealed, that it_is having_been_worked in god.

[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[5] in_circumcision the_eight_day of the_descent of_Israaʸl/(Yisrāʼēl) of_the_tribe of_Beniamin/(Binyāmīn), a_Hebraios of Hebraios, according_to the_law a_Farisaios_party_member,
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[6] according_to zeal persecuting the assembly, according_to righteousness which is by the_law having_become blameless.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[7] But which things was to_me gain, these I_have_considered because_of the chosen_one/messiah loss.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[8] But indeed_rather also I_am_considering all things loss to_be, because_of that being_above the knowledge of_chosen_one/messiah Yaʸsous the master of_me, because_of whom the things all I_was_lost and I_am_considering them rubbish, in_order_that chosen_one/messiah I_may_gain
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[9] and may_be_found in him, not having my own righteousness which of the_law, but the righteousness through faith in_chosen_one/messiah, the of god righteousness based on the faith,
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[10] which to_know him, and the power of_the resurrection of_him, and fellowship of_the_sufferings of_him, being_conformed to_the death of_him,
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[11] if somehow I_may_attain to the resurrection which from the_dead.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[12] Not that already I_received it, or already I_have_been_perfected, but I_am_pursuing, if also I_may_grasp, in that also I_was_grasped by chosen_one/messiah Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa).
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[13] Brothers, I myself not am_counting to_have_grasped it, but I_do one thing: the things on_one_hand behind forgetting, on_the_other_hand to_the things ahead stretching_out,
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[14] to the_goal I_am_pursuing for the prize of_the upward calling of_ the _god in chosen_one/messiah Yaʸsous.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[15] Therefore as_many_as mature are, this we_may_be_thinking, and if anything differently you_all_are_thinking, even this the god to_you_all will_be_revealing.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[16] However to what we_attained, by_the same thing to_be_aligning.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[17] Fellow-imitators of_me be_becoming, brothers, and be_observing the ones thus walking, as you_all_are_having for_an_example us.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[18] For/Because many are_walking, of_whom often I_was_telling to_you_all, and now even weeping, I_am_telling you, the enemies of_the stake of_the chosen_one/messiah,
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[19] whose the end is destruction, of_whose the god is their belly, and their glory is in the shame of_them, the ones the earthly things thinking.
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[20] For/Because of_us the citizenship in the_heavens is_being, from which also a_saviour we_are_eagerly_waiting, the_master Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) chosen_one/messiah,
[Filippaʸsios] [3]:[21] who will_be_adapting the body of_ the _humiliation of_us, similar to_the body of_the glory of_him, according_to the working of_the thing to_be_able him, even to_subject to_him the things all.
