[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [1]:[21] Therefore having_put_away all filthiness and abundance of_evil, in gentleness receive the implanted message, the one being_able to_save the souls of_you_all.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [1]:[22] And be_becoming doers of_the_message, and not only listeners deluding yourselves.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [1]:[23] Because if anyone a_listener of_the_message is, and not a_doer, this one is_like to_man observing his face of_ the _existence of_him in a_mirror.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [1]:[24] For/Because he_observed himself and has_gone_away, and immediately he_forgot what_kind he_was.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [1]:[25] But the one having_investigated into the_law perfect, the law of_ the _freedom, and having_continued_with it, not a_listener of_forgetful having_become, but a_doer of_the_work, this one blessed in the doing of_him will_be.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [1]:[26] If anyone is_supposing religious to_be, not bridling the_tongue of_himself, but seducing the_heart of_him, of_this one useless is his religion.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [1]:[27] Religion pure and undefiled before our god and father this is: to_be_visiting orphans and widows in the tribulation of_them, spotless himself to_be_keeping from the world.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[1] Brothers of_me, not with favouritism be_holding the faith of_the master of_us, Yaʸsous/(Yəhōshūˊa) chosen_one/messiah, of_ the _glory.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[2] For/Because if may_come_in into the_synagogue of_you_all, a_man gold_ring, in clothing splendid, and may_come_in also a_poor man, in filthy clothing,
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[3] and you_all_may_look_at on the one wearing the clothing the splendid, and you_all_may_say: You be_sitting here good, and to_the poor you_all_may_say: You stand there, or: Be_sitting under the footstool of_me,
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[4] not you_all_were_distinguished among yourselves, and became judges with_speculations evil?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[5] Hear, brothers of_me beloved: not the god chose the poor in_the world, rich in faith to_be, and heirs of_the kingdom which he_promised to_the ones loving him?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[6] But you_all dishonoured the poor. Not the rich are_oppressing over_you_all, and they are_dragging you_all into courts?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[7] Not they are_slandering the good name which having_been_called on you_all?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[8] If however the_law you_all_are_accomplishing royal, according_to the scripture: You_will_be_loving the neighbour of_you as yourself, well you_all_are_doing.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[9] But if you_all_are_showing_favouritism, sin you_all_are_doing, being_rebuked by the law as transgressors.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[10] For/Because whoever all the law may_keep, but may_stumble in one thing, has_become of_all liable.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[11] For/Because the one having_said: Not you_may_commit_adultery, said also: Not you_may_murder. And if not you_are_committing_adultery, but you_are_murdering you_have_become a_transgressor of_the_law.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[12] Thus be_speaking, and thus be_doing, as by the_law of_freedom going to_be_being_judged.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[13] For/Because the judgement merciless will_be to_the one not having_doing mercy. Is_triumphing mercy over_judgement.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[14] What is profit, brothers of_me, if faith may_be_saying anyone, to_be_having but, works not may_be_having? Not is_able the faith to_save him?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[15] If a_brother or a_sister naked may_be_being, and lacking of_ the _daily food,
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[16] and may_say anyone to_them from you_all: Be_going in peace, be_warming and be_satisfying, not but you_all_may_give to_them the necessary things for_their body, what is profit?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[17] Thus also the faith, if not it_may_be_having works, dead it_is by itself.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[18] But will_be_saying someone: You faith are_having, and_I works am_having. Show to_me the faith of_you without the works, and_I to_you will_be_showing by the works of_me the faith.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[19] You are_believing that one is the god. Well you_are_doing, even the demons are_believing and are_shuddering.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[20] But you_are_wanting to_know, Oh person vain, that the faith apart_from the works idle is?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[21] Abraʼam/(ʼAⱱrāhām) the father of_us not by works was_justified, having_offered_up Isaʼak/(Yiʦḩāq) the son of_him on the altar?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[22] You_are_seeing that his faith was_working_together with_the works of_him, and by his works his faith was_perfected.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[23] And was_fulfilled the scripture which saying: And believed Abraʼam in_- god, and it_was_counted to_him for righteousness, and a_friend of_god he_was_called.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[24] You_all_are_seeing that by works is_being_justified a_person, and not by faith only.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[25] And likewise also Ɽaⱪab/(Rāḩāⱱ) the prostitute not by works was_justified, having_welcomed the messengers and by_another way having_sent_forth?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [2]:[26] For/Because as the body apart_from spirit dead is, thus also the faith apart_from works dead is.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[1] Not many teachers be_becoming, brothers of_me, having_known that greater judgement we_will_be_receiving.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[2] For/Because in_many ways we_are_stumbling all. If anyone in his_message not is_stumbling, this a_perfect man is, powerful to_bridle also all his body.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[3] And, if of_the horses the bridles into the mouths we_are_putting, in_order that to_be_being_persuaded them to_us, also all the body of_them we_are_directing.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[4] Behold, also the ships, so_great being, and by winds hard being_driven, is_being_directed by the_least rudder, wherever the impulse of_the one straightening is_wishing.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[5] Thus also the tongue a_small member is, and great things is_boasting. Behold, how_much fire, how_much a_forest is_kindling.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[6] And the tongue is a_fire, the world of_ the _unrighteousness, the tongue is_being_set_down among the members of_us, which staining all the body, and setting_on_fire the course of_ the _existence, and being_set_on_fire by the geenna.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[7] For/Because every nature of_wild_beasts both and of_birds, of_reptiles both and of_sea creatures, is_being_tamed and has_been_tamed by_the nature the human,
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[8] but the tongue no_one to_tame is_able of_the_people, an_unstable evil, full of_poison deadly.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[9] In it we_are_blessing our master and father, and in it we_are_cursing the people, the ones according_to the_likeness of_god having_become.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[10] Out_of the same mouth is_coming_out blessing and curse. Not is_ought brothers of_me these things thus to_be_becoming.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[11] Surely_not the spring out_of of_the same hole is_outflowing the sweet and the bitter?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[12] Not is_able, brothers of_me, a_fig_tree olives to_produce or a_vine figs? Nor salt sweet to_produce water.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[13] Who is wise and understanding among you_all? Him_let_show out_of his good conduct the works of_him in the_gentleness of_wisdom.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[14] But if jealousy bitter you_all_are_having, and selfish_ambition in the heart of_you_all, not be_boasting and be_lying against the truth.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[15] Not is this the wisdom from_above coming_down, but earthly, soulish, demonic.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[16] For/Because where jealousy and selfish_ambition is, there is disturbance and every evil matter.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[17] But the from_above wisdom, first indeed pure is, then peaceable, gentle, compliant, full of_mercy and of_fruits good, unceasing, unhypocritical.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [3]:[18] And the_fruit of_righteousness in peace is_being_sown, by_the ones making peace.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[1] From_where wars and from_where quarrels among you_all are? Not is_it from_here from the gratifications of_you_all, which warring in the members of_you_all?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[2] You_all_are_desiring and not you_all_are_having, you_all_are_murdering and are_being_jealous, and not you_all_are_being_able to_obtain, you_all_are_quarrelling and you_all_are_warring. Not you_all_are_having, because_of that not to_be_requesting you_all,
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[3] you_are_requesting and not you_all_are_receiving, because wrongly you_all_are_requesting, in_order_that in the gratifications of_you_all you_all_may_spend it.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[4] Adultresses. Not you_all_have_known that the friendship with_the world, enmity the of_god is? Whoever therefore if may_be_wished a_friend to_be of_the world, an_enemy of_ the _god is_being_appointed.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[5] Or you_all_are_supposing that emptily the scripture is_saying: With envy is_longing_for the spirit which is made_to_dwell in us?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[6] But greater he_is_giving grace. Therefore he_is_saying: - god against_the_proud is_opposing, but to_the_humble he_is_giving grace.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[7] Therefore be_subjected to_ the _god. But resist against_the devil, and he_will_be_fleeing from you_all.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[8] Near to_ the _god, and he_will_be_nearing to_you_all. Cleanse your_hands, sinners, and purify your_hearts, double-minded.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[9] Be_miserable, and mourn, and weep. The laughter of_you_all to mourning let_be_turned, and your joy to gloominess.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[10] Be_humbled before the_master, and he_will_be_exalting you_all.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[11] Not be_slandering against_one_another, brothers. The one slandering against_his_brother or judging the brother of_him, is_slandering against_the_law and is_judging the_law. But if the_law you_are_judging, not you_are a_doer of_the_law, but a_judge.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[12] one there_is lawgiver and judge, the one being_able to_save and to_destroy. But you who are, the one judging your neighbour?
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[13] Be_come now, you_all saying: Today or tomorrow, we_will_be_going into this the city, and we_will_be_working there a_year, and we_will_be_merchandising, and we_will_be_profiting.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[14] Who not are_knowing on_the day next will_be, because/for what is life of_you_all? For/Because a_vapour you_all_are, which for a_little time appearing, then also being_perishing.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[15] Instead_of that to_be_saying you_all ought: If the master may_will, both we_will_be_living and we_will_be_doing, this or that.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[16] But now you_all_are_boasting in the arrogance of_you_all. All boasting such evil is.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [4]:[17] Therefore to_having_known one good to_be_doing, and not doing it, sin to_him it_is.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[1] Be_come now, you_all rich ones, weep, wailing over the miseries of_you_all which are coming_over.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[2] The riches of_you_all has_rotted, and the clothes of_you_all moth-eaten has_become.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[3] The gold of_you_all and the silver has_been_corroded, and the rust of_them for a_testimony to_you_all will_be, and will_be_consuming the fleshes of_you_all like fire. You_all_stored_up in the_last days.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[4] Behold, the wage of_the workers, which having_harvested the fields of_you_all, which having_been_withheld by you_all, is_crying_out, and the outcries of_the ones having_reaped, into the ears of_the_master of_armies have_come_in.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[5] You_all_indulged on the earth. And you_all_lived_luxuriously, you_all_nourished the hearts of_you_all in the_day of_slaughter.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[6] You_all_convicted, you_all_murdered the righteous, yet_not he_is_opposing against_you_all.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[7] Therefore be_patient, brothers, until the coming of_the master. Behold, the farmer is_awaiting for_the precious fruit of_the earth, being_patient for it until he_may_receive the_early and late rains.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[8] Be_patient also you_all, strengthen the hearts of_you_all, because the coming of_the master has_neared.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[9] Not be_groaning, brothers, against one_another, in_order_that not you_all_may_be_judged. Behold, the judge before the doors has_stood.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[10] An_example take, brothers, of_ the _misfortune, and of_ the _patience, the prophets, who spoke in name of_the_master.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[11] Behold, we_are_counting_blessed the ones having_endured. The endurance of_Iōb/(ʼIyyōⱱ) you_all_heard, and the outcome of_the_master you_all_saw, that much_compassionate is the master and compassionate.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[12] Before but, all things, brothers of_me, not be_swearing, neither the by_heaven, nor the earth, nor other any oath, but let_be of_you_all your Yes be, yes, and your No be, no, in_order_that not under judgement you_all_may_fall.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[13] Is_suffering_hardship anyone among you_all? Him _let_be_praying. Is_cheering_up anyone? Him _let_be_singing_praises.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[14] Is_ailing anyone among you_all? Him_let_call_to the elders of_the assembly, and them_let_pray over him, having_anointed him with_olive_oil in the name of_the master.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[15] And the vow of_ the _faith will_be_saving the one faltering, and will_be_raising him the master, and_if sins he_may_be having_done, it_will_be_being_forgiven to_him.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[16] Therefore be_confessing to_one_another your sins, and be_praying for one_another, so_that you_all_may_be_healed. Much is_prevailing the_petition of_a_righteous one working.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[17] Aʸlias/(ʼĒliyyāh) a_man was like_natured to_us, and with_prayer he_prayed which not for_it to_rain, and not it_rained on the earth, three years and six months.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[18] And again he_prayed, and the sky rain gave, and the earth sprouted the fruit of_it.
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[19] Brothers of_me, if anyone among you_all may_be_strayed from the truth, and may_turn_back someone him,
[Yakōbos/(Yaˊₐqoⱱ)] [5]:[20] be_knowing that the one having_turned_back a_sinner from the_deception of_the_way of_him, will_be_saving the_soul of_him from death, and will_be_covering a_multitude of_sins.

[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[4] For/Because some people sneaked_in which long_ago having_been_previously_written for this the judgement, ungodly ones, replacing the grace of_the god of_us into wantonness, and disowning the only master and master of_us, Yaʸsous chosen_one/messiah.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[5] And to_remind you_all I_am_wishing, having_perceived you_all once all things, that Yaʸsous having_saved a_people out_of the_land of_Aiguptos/(Miʦrayim), in_the second place destroyed the ones not having_believed.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[6] And the_messengers which not having_kept the rule of_themselves, but having_left_behind their own dwelling, has_kept in_ eternal _bonds under darkness to the_judgement of_the_great day.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[7] As Sodoma/(Şədom) and Gomorra/(ˊAmorāh), and the cities around them, having_fornicated the in_a_similar manner to_these, and having_gone_away after different flesh, they_are_lying_before an_example of_ the_justice undergoing eternal _fire.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[8] Likewise however also these dreaming ones, are_defiling the_flesh on_one_hand, on_the_other_hand they_are_rejecting mastership, on_the_other_hand they_are_slandering glories.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[9] But the Miⱪaaʸl/(Mīkāʼēl) the archangel, when disputing with_the devil, was_discussing about the body of_Mōsaʸs/(Mosheh), dared not to_bring_ a_judgement of_slander _against, but said, the_master Might_give_rebuke to_you.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[10] But these as_much_as on_one_hand they_have_ not _known they_are_slandering, on_the_other_hand as_much_as naturally as the illogical animals are_understanding, they_are_being_corrupted in these things.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[11] Woe to_them. Because they_were_gone in_the way of_ the _Kain/(Qayin), and they_were_poured_out to_the deception the of_Balaʼam/(Bilˊām) for_reward, and in_the controversy of_ the _Kore/(Qoraḩ) they_perished.
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[12] These are the ones in the love_feasts of_you_all, stains fearlessly feasting_with, shepherding themselves, waterless clouds being_carried_away by of_winds, unfruitful late_autumn trees having_died_off twice having_been_uprooted,
[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[13] wild waves of_the_sea foaming_out the shame of_themselves, wandering stars, to_whom the darkness of_ the _darkness has_been_kept to the_age.

[Youdas/(Yəhūdāh)] [1]:[16] These are grumblings complaining, following according_to the lusts of_them, and the mouth of_them is_speaking arrogant messages, marvelling people for_reason_of benefit.
